program_solutions:
(rule!
  (let ((divs (filter (lambda (c)
                        (all? (lambda (r) (= (at g r c) 5))
                              (range 0 h)))
                      (range 0 w))))
    (if (empty? divs)
        g
        (let ((divider (first divs)))
          (cellmap g (r c v)
            (let ((src-c (- (* 2 divider) c)))
              (if (and (> c divider)
                       (in-bounds? r src-c h w)
                       (!= (at g r src-c) 0)
                       (!= (at g r src-c) 5))
                  (at g r src-c)
                  v)))))))
